title: Create: Eye of the Storm
description: Welcome to Create: Eye of the Storm. A PvP/PvE Create/VS server. The goal is to have a pretty standard survival multiplayer experience, war or not, and players are given around 2 weeks to prepare for the Witherstorm
body:
_The bedrock is cracked, and the void seeps into the Overworld. Anything from beyond can enter..._

Welcome to **Create: Eye of the Storm**. A PvP/PvE Create/Valkyrien Skies server. The goal is to have a pretty standard survival multiplayer experience, war or not, and players are given around 2 weeks to prepare for doomsday. In the center of the world is the void well, where the clock tower emerged.

**Phase 1**
There is no other-worldly threat, Players simply play create mod how they normally would. Build an enterprise, go to war, make a megabase, whatever.

**Phase 2**
The Witherstorm is summoned, and all dimensions are shut off. any alliances, weapons, or builds are put to the test. It knows where you are, you can't outrun it on foot, it will collapse any cave or underground structure, and will target and pick up physics objects. Progression is the same as default, eventually someone will make the Formidi-bomb and destroy it.

**Phase 3**
The Witherstorm is back up, even stronger. Now the progression is different. After awakening, Multiple Witherstorm Segments will spawn around the world, and must be defeated with your military might to progress. if completed, you'll fight a different mini-boss for specific materials to craft a special cannon shell to use and reveal the command block. The final fight won't be easy...
